title: Proxima b Surface
explanation: An artist's impression of the rocky exoplanet Proxima b orbiting the nearest star to the Sun.

title: Lava World 55 Cancri e
explanation: A 10K artist's concept of the super-Earth 55 Cancri e, a hot rocky planet with a partially molten surface.

title: WASP-121 b
explanation: A hot Jupiter artist impression showing the strongly irradiated exoplanet WASP-121 b near its host star.

title: K2-18 b
explanation: A distant view of exoplanet K2-18 b and its red-dwarf host star in an artist's concept.

title: GJ 1132 b
explanation: A rocky exoplanet artist impression set against the Milky Way and its host star.

title: Neutron Star Merger
explanation: An artist's impression of two merging neutron stars producing a bright kilonova.

title: M87 Black Hole Concept
explanation: An artist's impression of the supermassive black hole at the center of Messier 87 and its hot accretion flow.

title: HD 131399Ab
explanation: A triple-star exoplanet artist impression with three suns visible from a distant giant world.

title: Isolated Stellar-Mass Black Hole
credit: ESA/Hubble, Digitized Sky Survey, Nick Risinger, N. Bartmann
explanation: A Milky Way star field distorted by an isolated stellar-mass black hole in this artist's impression.

title: Surface of TRAPPIST-1f
explanation: An exoplanet surface concept with icy terrain, orange twilight, and neighboring TRAPPIST-1 worlds in the sky.
